items.title: Hister: A private search engine for the pages you visit and the files you keep
items.summary: Hister is a new open-source search engine designed to help users privately search through their visited web pages and stored files. This development is significant for developers and engineers focused on privacy and data management solutions.

items.title: Astra for Law
items.summary: OpenAI has launched Astra for Law, a specialized AI model aimed at assisting legal professionals with document analysis and case research. This advancement highlights the growing role of AI in transforming traditional industries like law.

items.title: CrowdSec Source Code Leak
items.summary: CrowdSec has reported a significant source code leak, raising concerns about security vulnerabilities and the importance of safeguarding open-source projects. Developers should be aware of the implications this has for trust and security in collaborative software development.

items.title: Rate limits on GitLab.com are changing
items.summary: GitLab has announced changes to its rate limits, which will affect how users interact with its API and services. Developers need to adapt to these changes to ensure their applications continue to function smoothly and efficiently.

items.title: Infinite-Parameter LLMs: Generating and Adapting Weights from Live Data
items.summary: A new research paper discusses the concept of Infinite-Parameter LLMs, which can generate and adapt their weights based on live data inputs. This innovation could significantly enhance the capabilities of AI models, making them more dynamic and responsive.
